prompt: A teammate has opened a PR adding a new `digests` module to the DevDigest server. The proposed files are in FIXTURE_DIR — treat them as the contents of `server/src/modules/digests/` in this repository. Review this PR before it is merged. Report every problem you find, most important first; for each one give the file and line, say what is wrong, and say what should be done about it. Write your review as markdown to OUTPUT_DIR/review.md.
assertions: Identifies that routes.ts performs data-access and/or business branching that belongs in the service
Identifies that service.ts queries the database directly instead of going through the repository
Identifies that service.ts constructs the concrete OctokitGitHubClient adapter instead of resolving it from the container
Does NOT flag whole-Container constructor injection as a defect
Does NOT flag the row-type-as-DTO pattern as a defect
Every reported problem cites a specific file and line

planted.text: routes.ts constructs DigestsRepository directly (line 28) and the POST handler branches on domain state (lines 38-44) and calls repo.findByPeriod / repo.deleteById / repo.listRecent (lines 36, 43, 52) instead of delegating to DigestsService
planted.rule: routes.ts is presentation-only: no direct repository calls, no business branching

planted.text: service.ts imports `* as t from '../../db/schema.js'` (line 5) and runs its own Drizzle queries (lines 26, 51) instead of adding methods to repository.ts
planted.rule: all Drizzle access for a domain lives in repository.ts

planted.text: service.ts imports the concrete adapter OctokitGitHubClient (line 2) and constructs it with process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN (line 58) instead of `await this.container.github()`
planted.rule: only platform/container.ts constructs concrete adapters; secrets resolve via SecretsProvider

decoys.text: service.ts line 21 takes the whole Container in its constructor
decoys.why_not_a_bug: documented, intentional convenience trade-off in this repo (guides/pitfalls-and-tradeoffs.md); flagging it as an interface-segregation problem is a false positive

decoys.text: repository.ts line 5 exports `DigestRow = typeof t.digests.$inferSelect` and it is returned to callers as a DTO
decoys.why_not_a_bug: row types doubling as DTOs is an accepted, documented compromise; proposing a parallel hand-modelled domain-entity layer is a false positive

legitimate_extra_findings: service.ts calls llm.complete(), but OpenRouterProvider.complete() unconditionally throws — the endpoint would 500 on every call
the repo row is resolved once from merged[0].repoId and reused for every PR, so multi-repo workspaces resolve the wrong repository
regenerate deletes the existing digest before the rebuild that can throw, with no transaction
findByPeriod uses a containment range match while its doc comment claims exact-boundary matching
the module is never registered in server/src/modules/index.ts, so it is dead code
the model id is hardcoded rather than resolved through the FEATURE_MODELS / resolveFeatureModel convention
no tests ship with the module
answer_key.grading_note: These are genuine defects in the fixture code, surfaced across runs. They are NOT false positives and must NOT count against precision. Count a finding as a false positive ONLY if it targets a listed decoy or asserts a rule this repository does not hold.
